item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: エーテルの砂時計～ANGEL TIME～
  • 英語名: Ether no Sunadokei Angel Time

あらすじ

There is a town on the border of two worlds where lost things gather.

Main character belongs to the faction of town protectors. He died and then got resurrected, so all his power is lost now. He decides to live like a normal person in the circle of friends, but things start to change around him…

item.title: Asa no Konai Yoru ni Dakarete -Eternal Night-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: DreamSoft
  • 発売日: 2002-06-28
  • スコア: 6.55/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 朝の来ない夜に抱かれて -ETERNAL NIGHT-
  • 英語名: Asa no Konai Yoru ni Dakarete -Eternal Night-

あらすじ

Tatsuto gets along well with his childhood friend, Misora. Days pass happily until a monster appears from the “gate of the other world” and kills Tatsuto, who then makes a contract with an evil god to be revived. The monster is quickly slain by the revived Tatsuto, but this is only the beginning of the battle that approaches.

item.title: Beside ~Shiawase wa Katawara ni~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: DreamSoft
  • 発売日: 2001-10-26
  • スコア: 6.2700000000000005/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Beside～幸せはかたわらに～
  • 英語名: Beside Shiawase wa Katawara ni

あらすじ

When I was young, I fell in love.

I loved her from a very early age, and she was like a big sister to me. Her mother died when she was little, and her father was always working.

But, she went to college, and had to move.

I confessed my feelings to her, but the train’s noise took her answer away with the wind.
